originalTitle: Apple acknowledges iPhone Duo display ‘issue’ after reports of cracked screens
summary: Following reports of iPhone Duos with cracked and broken inside screens, often showing a bright line running from the center to the right side, Apple says in a statement to Bloomberg and 9to5Mac that it's aware of "an issue impacting the inner display" on a "small number of iPhone Duo units." content: Following reports of iPhone Duos with cracked and broken inside screens, often showing a bright line running from the center to the right side, Apple says in a statement to Bloomberg and 9to5Mac that it’s aware of “an issue impacting the inner display” on a “small number of iPhone Duo units.” If your iPhone Duo is affected, Apple says to contact AppleCare for a replacement. Here is the full statement, which Apple’s Alex Kirschner shared with The Verge: > The response to iPhone Duo from early users has been incredibly positive, and we are seeing exciting things from developers who are rapidly updating their apps to take advantage of its unique form factor. We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units. If users experience issues with their iPhone Duo display, they should contact AppleCare for a replacement. Kirshner says most units aren’t susceptible and that the issues appear quickly on units with the defect. Shortly after launch, iPhone Duo users started reporting similar issues where the hinge would tighten, and opening the device caused a crack and the distinctive bright lines on the display. One user in Australia said that an Apple Store replaced their unit “on the spot.” This weekend, iFixit published its teardown of the phone and gave its perspective on why some phones might be cracking. Where the damage has been happening, iFixit shows how the foldable screen might be pushing against a center bar. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WOVIjFnivJA] The Verge has contacted Apple about the reports, but has not received an on-the-record response about the issues with these new phones. They’re some of the first devices to launch after new CEO John Ternus took over from Tim Cook. Updates, October 26th: Added Apple’s statement and additional context.
chineseTitle: 苹果在屏幕破裂报道后承认 iPhone Duo 显示“问题”
chineseSummary: 继有报道称 iPhone Duo 的内部屏幕出现破裂和破损，并且经常显示从中心到右侧的亮线时，苹果公司在给彭博社和 9to5Mac 的一份声明中表示，它已经意识到“少数 iPhone Duo 设备”上的“一个影响内部显示屏的问题”。如果您的 iPhone Duo [...]
chineseContent: 继有报道称 iPhone Duo 的内部屏幕出现破裂和破损，并且经常显示从中心到右侧的亮线时，苹果公司在给彭博社和 9to5Mac 的一份声明中表示，它已经意识到“少数 iPhone Duo 设备”上的“一个影响内部显示屏的问题”。如果您的 iPhone Duo 受到影响，Apple 表示请联系 AppleCare 进行更换。以下是 Apple 的 Alex Kirschner 与 The Verge 分享的完整声明： > 早期用户对 iPhone Duo 的反应非常积极，我们看到开发人员正在快速更新他们的应用程序以利用其独特的外形，这是令人兴奋的事情。我们发现少数 iPhone Duo 设备的内部显示屏存在问题。如果用户的 iPhone Duo 显示屏出现问题，应联系 AppleCare 寻求更换。科什纳表示，大多数设备都不易受到影响，并且在存在缺陷的设备上问题很快就会出现。发布后不久，iPhone Duo 用户开始报告类似的问题，即铰链会收紧，打开设备会导致破裂，显示屏上出现明显的亮线。澳大利亚的一位用户表示，苹果商店“当场”更换了他们的设备。本周末，iFixit 发布了这款手机的拆解报告，并对某些手机可能出现裂纹的原因给出了自己的看法。在发生损坏的地方，iFixit 展示了可折叠屏幕如何推向中心杆。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WOVIjFnivJA] The Verge 已就这些报道联系了苹果公司，但尚未收到有关这些新手机问题的公开回应。它们是新任首席执行官约翰·特纳斯 (John Ternus) 接替蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 后首批推出的设备之一。 10 月 26 日更新：添加了 Apple 的声明
